deploymentGoal: Deploy the first private backend alpha to staging with fixture data only, protected secrets, USD test billing, executable smoke proof, monitoring, backup, rollback, and go/no-go gates before any pilot user touches live data.

environmentLanes.name: Staging URL
environmentLanes.proof: HTTPS, cache headers, release version, and admin-only deployment notes are visible.

environmentLanes.name: API service
environmentLanes.proof: Health, version, auth, and smoke endpoints respond from the release candidate.

environmentLanes.name: Database
environmentLanes.proof: Tenant, users, access, records, commercial vault, imports, audit, billing, and feedback tables migrate.

environmentLanes.name: Object storage
environmentLanes.proof: Smoke reports, reconciliation files, screenshots, backup manifests, and redaction proof are stored.

environmentLanes.name: Email
environmentLanes.proof: Invites, resets, invoice notices, support mail, and report delivery cannot blast real recipients.

environmentLanes.name: Billing
environmentLanes.proof: USD 5 per user checkout, invoice, webhook, seat sync, and access lock work without live cards.

environmentLanes.name: Monitoring
environmentLanes.proof: API health, DB connections, error rate, audit writes, webhook failures, and backup job are visible.

environmentLanes.name: Backup
environmentLanes.proof: Snapshot is created before pilot import rehearsal and restored into a clean database.

secrets.purpose: Staging database connection string with least-privilege app user.
Long random session signing secret, never reused from local development.
Canonical staging app URL for redirects, links, and cookies.
USD test-mode billing provider key; live keys stay out of staging.
Webhook signature secret for invoice, checkout, renewal, cancel, and seat events.
Artifact bucket key limited to staging evidence and report exports.
Test-sink email provider key with no real customer recipient delivery.
Short-lived key or service account for release evidence export.
Error and access-log drain for deployment and smoke monitoring.
Key used to encrypt staging snapshots and restore rehearsal artifacts.

runbook.title: Freeze release candidate
runbook.proof: Tag exact commit, lock scope, confirm owner matrix, and link sprint-zero closing issue.

runbook.title: Pull clean environment
runbook.proof: Create or refresh staging app, API service, database, storage bucket, log drain, and test email route.

runbook.title: Install and build
runbook.proof: Run install, type checks, build, database client generation, and static asset build from a clean clone.

runbook.title: Run migrations
runbook.proof: Apply schema migrations in order and capture migration id, duration, and rollback note.

runbook.title: Seed fixtures
runbook.proof: Load tenant, users, access profiles, operational records, commercial vault, import batches, and audit seeds.

runbook.title: Prove redaction
runbook.proof: Frontline tracker routes, CSV export, and non-management users cannot see commercial facts.

runbook.title: Run smoke script
runbook.proof: Auth, records, redaction, import, billing, feedback, audit, rollback, and report evidence are produced.

runbook.title: Create backup snapshot
runbook.proof: Snapshot exists after fixture seed and before any pilot import rehearsal.

runbook.title: Watch the dashboard
runbook.proof: Health, logs, error rate, audit writes, webhook status, queue jobs, and backup job are reviewed.

runbook.title: Hold go/no-go review
runbook.proof: Gates, evidence artifacts, open blockers, rollback proof, and pilot handoff are reviewed before enabling users.

databaseChecks: All schema migrations apply from an empty database without manual patching.
Every route query is tenant-scoped and rejects cross-tenant identifiers with audit evidence.
Operational records load with tracker-safe fields only.
Commercial vault fields stay restricted from frontline routes and CSV exports.
Import batches keep workbook, sheet, dry-run, quarantine, commit, rollback, and reconciliation lineage.
Audit events exist for login, denied access, edits, commercial reads, imports, billing, backup, and smoke paths.
Snapshot restore is rehearsed into a clean database and counts reconcile.
Failed migration recovery keeps audit evidence and writes a rollback note.
monitoringChecks: Frontend, API, auth, and version health endpoints respond.
Database pool, slow queries, and migration failures are visible.
Unhandled exceptions, failed requests, and smoke failures create alerts.
Sensitive allow and deny audit writes are counted and exportable.
Billing webhook test events produce signed logs.
Import dry-run, quarantine, commit, rollback, and reconciliation jobs report status.
Backup snapshot, restore rehearsal, and retention checks are visible.
Feedback capture, retest state, sponsor export, and support owner flow are tracked.
rollbackPlan: Stop pilot access or move staging behind maintenance before destructive recovery.
Preserve logs, audit events, smoke artifacts, migration id, backup id, and error samples.
Restore the last verified staging snapshot and reconcile tenant, user, record, and vault counts.
Redeploy the previous release candidate and verify API version, assets, and environment variables.
Repeat auth, records, redaction, import, billing, audit, feedback, and report smoke paths.
Write incident note with impact, root cause, owner, fix PR, retest evidence, and go/no-go decision.

ownerMatrix.accountability: Deploy window, go/no-go call, smoke evidence, rollback decision, and launch notes.
API service, route health, migrations, fixtures, route guards, and build errors.
Migration order, seed load, backup snapshot, restore rehearsal, and reconciliation.
Tenant isolation, commercial redaction, audit proof, secret handling, and denied-access evidence.
USD test checkout, webhook signature, invoice state, seat sync, and access locks.
Pilot scope, acceptance gates, customer handoff, blocker decisions, and sponsor message.

stopRules: Do not enable live customer data in staging.
Do not load live billing keys.
Do not merge code that leaks commercial vault fields to tracker routes.
Do not proceed without a backup snapshot and restore path.
Do not proceed if smoke artifacts are missing.
Do not enable pilot users until go/no-go gates are reviewed.
